title: Ravi river flood, Ajnala and Ramdass belt, Amritsar district, Punjab (India), August 2025

sources.label: The Tribune: about 23,000 ha of standing crops destroyed in Ajnala since 27 August, when the Ravi first entered villages
The Tribune: Ghonewal and Machhiwala worst hit after a breach in the Dhussi Bandh; Ajnala and Ramdass belt
The Tribune: floodwater reached about 10 km from the Ravi bank
The Tribune e-paper, 11 Sep 2025: about 20 breaches along the Ravi, nearly 190 villages inundated in Ajnala and Lopoke
The Tribune: paddy on 3,47,601 acres impacted in Gurdaspur, Amritsar, Fazilka, Kapurthala and Tarn Taran
SPHERE India situation report: flood escalated in late August and peaked in early September 2025

controls_note: ASSUMED non-event seasons (same point, same dates, one and two years earlier). Verify that no flood affected the point in those seasons before quoting these numbers.
